sources.title: Using Marine Plans
sources.facts: Marine plans inform authorisation and other public-authority decisions affecting English marine areas.
sources.guard: A marine plan or policy assessment does not prove a licence, permission or exact-site compatibility.

sources.title: Marine licensing jurisdiction
sources.facts: Explains where marine licensing applies, including tidal rivers, estuaries and English waters.
sources.guard: Jurisdiction guidance does not determine whether a specific activity is licensable or exempt.

sources.title: Get permission for marine work
sources.facts: Routes activities to marine licences, exemptions and other permissions.
sources.guard: A routing result does not prove all permissions are identified, granted or discharged.

sources.title: Make a marine licence application
sources.facts: Describes application, validation, fees, determination and monitoring stages.
sources.guard: An application or validation step is not a licence decision or evidence of compliance.

sources.title: Guidance to help complete a marine licence application
sources.facts: Explains information expected in standard marine-licence applications.
sources.guard: Complete documentation does not guarantee validation, consent or acceptable impacts.

sources.title: Marine licensing impact assessments
sources.facts: Explains screening and EIA information for marine works with potential significant effects.
sources.guard: Screening or an environmental statement does not prove effects are acceptable or mitigated.

sources.title: Marine Licensing Top Tips
sources.facts: Provides pre-application, validation, consultation and process-flow guidance for ports-sector applications.
sources.guard: Process advice does not prove an application is complete, timely or consentable.

sources.title: A coastal concordat for England
sources.facts: Provides a voluntary framework for coordinating marine licences and terrestrial planning permissions.
sources.guard: Coordination does not replace statutory decisions or prove either consent has been granted.
